content:
The City of Laredo is inviting the community to celebrate culture, tradition and remembrance at the fourth annual Día de los Muertos celebration on Saturday, Nov. 7, from 4 to 9 p.m. at North Central Park, 10202 International Blvd., according to the City of Laredo.

District 6 Council Member Dr. Tyler King and the Rotary Club of Laredo Next Generation joined the city to present this year's celebration, the city said. The evening will feature a Catrina Contest, food vendors, mariachi, ballet folklórico, informational booths and more, and the Día de los Muertos X RotaRun Glow 5K begins at 7 p.m.

A second celebration takes place across town the same evening: the 12th Annual Catrina Festival's Memorial Walk, which gathers at Vega's Interiores, 4002 San Bernardo, with the procession beginning at 6 p.m., according to Tragaluz. Mariachi Mezcal de Tejas and dancers from the Gabriela Mendoza García Folklórico will lead the 10-block walk to the Pan American Courts Arts Complex.

Sources: City of Laredo; Tragaluz.

title: Laredo Celebrates 4th Annual Día de los Muertos Tonight at North Central Park
